text:
cheng: FYI we just saw a partial failover on eu-db-2 during the canary traffic ramp, increased p95 write latency ~800ms.
maria: yikes. Any user-facing errors? @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: some transient 503s on write paths for a subset of tenants in eu. We rolled to replica but still seeing slow recovery.
simon: what's the status of the release queue? we've got a scheduled slot in 18m for orbit v2.3.1
deploy-bot: Scheduled release (orbit v2.3.1) starts in 18m. Current policy: auto-pause for active incidents in region eu.
cheng: ok can we skip this slot and roll it forward one window? prefer not to risk canary while DB is unstable.
tara: agree. If we skip, we should also clear any dependent migrations and create a hotpatch plan for the next available slot.
pri: @cheng can you confirm no DB schema changes in v2.3.1? I thought it was just runtime flags and telemetry.
cheng: correct — no schema changes. main risk is read/write amplification during cache warmup; with DB spotty it could amplify.
ops-oncall: recommend: block EU release slot, reschedule to next change window (3h), set canary at 1% then 10% with 30min hold checks. Also we'll run extra health checks on eu-db-2.
simon: sounds good. Can we attach a condition to the deploybot so it auto-aborts if p95 > 300ms for 5m during canary?
deploy-bot: New constraint added to release job orbit v2.3.1: "eu-p95-write < 300ms over 5m". Will abort and notify if violated.
maria: please add a manual checkpoint for ops sign-off before broad rollout.
deploy-bot: Release job updated: canary phases [1% -> 10% -> 100%], automatic abort thresholds set, requires tag `ops:approved` for broad rollout.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor. If DB hasn't recovered in 3h we should also consider moving the slot to next day and notify customers in affected cohort.
cheng: agree. I'll open a brief release note draft explaining the defer and the reason (DB failover) so PM can approve comms.
pri: small nit — let's also gate the release on kv-cache warming not exceeding 2x baseline cpu on inference pods.
tara: added to checklist. also create a follow-up action item to run canary traffic against eu-read-replica in staging to reproduce.
simon: thanks all. @deploy-bot, please skip current slot and schedule to 3h from now with the constraints above.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Current slot skipped. New tentative slot scheduled at 1712350790 (3h). Will send reminders and require `ops:approved` before broad rollout.
maria: tagging PMs and CS: @mike @elena — heads up we'll move orbit release out 3h due to EU DB failover, no schema changes.
cheng: ops-oncall — after DB is stable, let's run a short soak (1h) at 1% before progressing.
ops-oncall: noted. I'll post a quick health summary once p95 drops below 200ms for 15m.
cheng: thanks. ending thread, will update when we get ops sign-off. :thumbsup:
